import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

import httpx
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import main


class TrendsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        main._cache.clear()
        self.client = TestClient(main.app)

    def test_country_and_limit_validation(self):
        for query in ("geo=ZZ", "limit=0", "limit=21"):
            self.assertEqual(self.client.get(f"/api/trends?{query}").status_code, 422)

    def test_feed_transformation_and_cache(self):
        content = b'<rss xmlns:ht="https://trends.google.com/trending/rss"><channel><item><title>Python</title><ht:approx_traffic>200+</ht:approx_traffic><pubDate>today</pubDate></item><item><title>Go</title></item></channel></rss>'
        async def get(*args, **kwargs):
            return httpx.Response(200, content=content, request=httpx.Request("GET", "https://trends.google.com"))
        with patch.object(httpx.AsyncClient, "get", side_effect=get) as upstream:
            first = self.client.get("/api/trends?limit=1").json()
            second = self.client.get("/api/trends?limit=2").json()
        self.assertEqual(first["items"][0]["traffic"], "200+")
        self.assertFalse(first["cached"])
        self.assertEqual(len(second["items"]), 2)
        self.assertTrue(second["cached"])
        self.assertEqual(upstream.call_count, 1)

    def test_upstream_failure_is_explained(self):
        with patch.object(httpx.AsyncClient, "get", side_effect=httpx.ConnectError("offline")):
            response = self.client.get("/api/trends")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 502)

    def test_allowed_origin(self):
        response = self.client.get("/health", headers={"Origin": "http://localhost:4173"})
        self.assertEqual(response.headers["access-control-allow-origin"], "http://localhost:4173")

    def test_news_requires_topic_and_never_returns_trending(self):
        for params in ({}, {"q": ""}, {"q": "   "}):
            self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/news", params=params).status_code, 422)
        response = httpx.Response(200, content=b'<rss><channel><item><title>News</title><link>https://news.google.com/example</link></item></channel></rss>', request=httpx.Request("GET", "https://news.google.com"))
        with patch.object(httpx.AsyncClient, "get", return_value=response):
            result = self.client.get("/api/news", params={"q": "Python"}).json()
        self.assertEqual(result["mode"], "news")
        self.assertNotIn("traffic", result["items"][0])

    def test_topic_search_uses_news_and_keeps_caches_separate(self):
        content = b'<rss><channel><item><title>Python news</title><link>https://news.google.com/articles/example</link><source>Publisher</source></item></channel></rss>'
        async def get(url, **kwargs):
            return httpx.Response(200, content=content, request=httpx.Request("GET", url, params=kwargs["params"]))
        with patch.object(httpx.AsyncClient, "get", side_effect=get) as upstream:
            news = self.client.get("/api/trends", params={"q": "  Python  ", "geo": "US"}).json()
            cached = self.client.get("/api/trends", params={"q": "PYTHON", "geo": "US"}).json()
            different = self.client.get("/api/trends", params={"q": "Go", "geo": "US"}).json()
            trending = self.client.get("/api/trends", params={"geo": "US"}).json()
        self.assertEqual(news["mode"], "news")
        self.assertEqual(news["query"], "Python")
        self.assertEqual(cached["query"], "PYTHON")
        self.assertEqual(news["items"][0]["publisher"], "Publisher")
        self.assertIn("news.google.com/rss/search", news["source"])
        self.assertTrue(cached["cached"])
        self.assertFalse(different["cached"])
        self.assertEqual(trending["mode"], "trending")
        self.assertEqual(upstream.call_count, 3)
        self.assertEqual(upstream.call_args_list[0].kwargs["params"]["hl"], "en-US")

    def test_topic_validation_and_no_results(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/trends", params={"q": "x" * 101}).status_code, 422)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/trends", params={"q": "bad\x00text"}).status_code, 422)
        response = httpx.Response(200, content=b'<rss><channel/></rss>', request=httpx.Request("GET", "https://news.google.com"))
        with patch.object(httpx.AsyncClient, "get", return_value=response):
            result = self.client.get("/api/trends", params={"q": "unusual topic"}).json()
        self.assertEqual(result["items"], [])

    def test_italian_news_uses_italian_source(self):
        async def get(url, **kwargs):
            return httpx.Response(200, content=b'<rss><channel/></rss>', request=httpx.Request("GET", url, params=kwargs["params"]))
        with patch.object(httpx.AsyncClient, "get", side_effect=get) as upstream:
            result = self.client.get("/api/news", params={"q": "tecnologia", "geo": "IT"})
        self.assertEqual(result.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(upstream.call_args.kwargs["params"]["hl"], "it-IT")
        self.assertEqual(upstream.call_args.kwargs["params"]["gl"], "IT")
        self.assertEqual(upstream.call_args.kwargs["params"]["ceid"], "IT:it")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sqlite3
import tempfile
import unittest
from contextlib import closing
from datetime import date

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import main

BROWSER = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 Firefox/130"}
class StatsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        main.reset()
        self.client = TestClient(main.app)

    def view(self, path="/", headers=BROWSER, **extra):
        return self.client.post("/api/stats/event", json={"type": "view", "path": path, **extra}, headers=headers)

    def test_views_clicks_and_dimensions_are_counted(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.view("/", lang="pt-BR", device="mobile", referrer="github.com").status_code, 204)
        self.view("/", lang="pt-BR", device="desktop")
        self.view("/app/", lang="en-US")
        self.client.post("/api/stats/event", json={"type": "click", "path": "/", "name": "contato:whatsapp"}, headers=BROWSER)
        data = self.client.get("/api/stats/summary?days=7").json()
        self.assertEqual(data["totals"], {"views": 3, "visitors": 1, "clicks": 1})
        self.assertEqual(data["pages"][0], {"key": "/", "total": 2})
        self.assertEqual(data["clicks"], [{"key": "contato:whatsapp", "total": 1}])
        self.assertEqual(data["referrers"], [{"key": "github.com", "total": 1}])
        self.assertEqual(len(data["daily"]), 7)
        self.assertEqual(data["daily"][-1]["views"], 3)

    def test_different_browsers_are_different_visitors(self):
        self.view()
        self.view(headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 Safari/17"})
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/stats/summary").json()["totals"]["visitors"], 2)

    def test_nothing_personal_is_stored(self):
        self.view(headers={**BROWSER, "X-Forwarded-For": "203.0.113.9"})
        stored = " ".join(str(value) for row in main.database().execute("SELECT * FROM counts") for value in row)
        self.assertNotIn("203.0.113.9", stored)
        self.assertNotIn("Firefox", stored)
        self.assertEqual([column[1] for column in main.database().execute("PRAGMA table_info(counts)")], ["day", "kind", "key", "total"])
        self.assertIsNone(main.database().execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='panel_auth'").fetchone())

    def test_invalid_events_are_rejected(self):
        for body in ({"type": "view"}, {"type": "x", "path": "/"}, {"type": "view", "path": "/<script>"}, {"type": "click", "path": "/", "name": "Nome Livre"}, {"type": "click", "path": "/"}):
            self.assertEqual(self.client.post("/api/stats/event", json=body, headers=BROWSER).status_code, 422, body)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post("/api/stats/event", content=b"x" * 700, headers=BROWSER).status_code, 413)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/stats/summary").json()["totals"]["views"], 0)

    def test_bots_are_ignored(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.view(headers={"User-Agent": "Googlebot/2.1"}).status_code, 204)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/stats/summary").json()["totals"]["views"], 0)

    def test_privacy_signals_are_ignored_by_server(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.view(headers={**BROWSER, "DNT": "1"}).status_code, 204)
        self.assertEqual(self.view(headers={**BROWSER, "Sec-GPC": "1"}).status_code, 204)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/stats/summary").json()["totals"]["views"], 0)

    def test_summary_is_public_without_a_password(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/stats/summary").status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/api/stats/summary", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer errada"}).status_code, 200)

    def test_old_password_verifier_is_removed_without_losing_counts(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            path = os.path.join(folder, "stats.sqlite3")
            with closing(sqlite3.connect(path)) as db:
                db.execute("CREATE TABLE panel_auth (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, salt BLOB, digest BLOB, rounds INTEGER)")
                db.execute("INSERT INTO panel_auth VALUES (1,?,?,?)", (b"old", b"old", 1))
                db.execute("CREATE TABLE counts (day TEXT, kind TEXT, key TEXT, total INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (day,kind,key))")
                db.execute("INSERT INTO counts VALUES (?,'view','/',3)", (date.today().isoformat(),))
                db.commit()
            main.reset(path)
            result = self.client.get("/api/stats/summary")
            self.assertEqual(result.status_code, 200)
            self.assertEqual(result.json()["totals"]["views"], 3)
            self.assertIsNone(main.database().execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='panel_auth'").fetchone())
            main.reset()

    def test_event_flood_is_limited_and_keys_are_capped(self):
        codes = [self.view().status_code for _ in range(95)]
        self.assertEqual(codes.count(204), 90)
        self.assertEqual(codes[-1], 429)
        main.reset()
        with main._lock:
            for index in range(main.MAX_KEYS + 5):
                main.add(main.database(), "2026-01-01", "click", f"k{index}")
        self.assertEqual(main.database().execute("SELECT total FROM counts WHERE key='outros'").fetchone()[0], 5)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

    build:
      context: .

name: Validate portfolio
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  web:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - run: npm run check
  fastapi:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: apps/trends-api
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.14'
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m unittest -v
  stats:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: apps/stats-api
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.14'
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m unittest -v
  go:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: apps/resume-api
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.26'
      - run: go test ./...
      - run: GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -o resume-api.exe .
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: resume-api-windows
          path: apps/resume-api/resume-api.exe
  kotlin:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.14.3'
      - run: gradle -p apps/resume-kotlin jsBrowserDistribution --no-daemon
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: resume-kotlin
          path: apps/resume-kotlin/build/dist/js/productionExecutable/

name: Android native app
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'apps/resume-android/**'
      - 'apps/resume-compose/**'
      - 'web/data/profile.json'
      - 'web/data/translations.json'
      - '.github/workflows/android.yml'
      - 'scripts/check-android.py'
jobs:
  apk:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.14.3'
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.android/debug.keystore
          key: karen-android-demo-signing-v1
      - run: gradle -p apps/resume-android assemblePortfolio --no-daemon
      - run: |
          mkdir -p android-artifacts
          cp apps/resume-android/app/build/outputs/apk/portfolio/app-portfolio.apk android-artifacts/karenangelis-curriculo.apk
          "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/35.0.0/apksigner" verify --verbose android-artifacts/karenangelis-curriculo.apk
          "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/35.0.0/aapt" dump badging android-artifacts/karenangelis-curriculo.apk > android-artifacts/apk-info.txt
          sha256sum android-artifacts/karenangelis-curriculo.apk > android-artifacts/SHA256SUMS
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: android-native-apk
          path: android-artifacts/
      - name: Enable emulator acceleration
        run: |
          echo 'KERNEL=="kvm", GROUP="kvm", MODE="0666", OPTIONS+="static_node=kvm"' | sudo tee /etc/udev/rules.d/99-kvm4all.rules
          sudo udevadm control --reload-rules
          sudo udevadm trigger --name-match=kvm
      - uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2
        with:
          api-level: 35
          arch: x86_64
          profile: pixel_2
          disable-animations: true
          emulator-options: -no-window -gpu swiftshader_indirect -noaudio -no-boot-anim -camera-back none -camera-front none -memory 2048 -cores 2
          script: python3 scripts/check-android.py
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: android-native-checks
          path: android-artifacts/
